question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum will ₹1,250 give ₹500 as simple interest in 10 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Annual Interest** = Total Interest ÷ Time = 500 ÷ 10 = ₹50

**Rate %** = (Annual Interest ÷ Principal) × 100

**Rate %** = (50 ÷ 1250) × 100 = 4%

**∴ The correct answer is 4%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = **₹1,250**

Simple Interest (SI) = **₹500**

Time (T) = **10 years**

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30a9e1bfb19170d35a5c6b2a144ac51e8065dda8f35488beea0282f00bdad76.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 500 = (1250 × R × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 500 = (12500 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ 500 = 125 × R

⇒ R = 500 ÷ 125

⇒ R = 4%

**∴ The correct answer is 4%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

The basic formula for **Simple Interest** is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate per annum, and T is Time in years.

Total Amount Formula

The **Amount** (A) at the end of the period is the sum of the Principal and the Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT ÷ 100).

Time Calculation

To find the **Time period** when other values are known: T = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R).

Principal Calculation

To find the **Principal** when interest, rate, and time are known: P = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T).
